summary: The CasC vars/all.yml sets aap_hostname (gateway URL, not component endpoints), aap_username, vaulted aap_password and aap_validate_certs, plus organization, team, user, role and custom role names. You can use aap_token instead of username and password.
questions: What variables do I need to connect ansible.platform to AAP?
Can I use a token instead of a password in CasC?
Example vars file for AAP Configuration as Code

answer_card.title: Connection variables for CasC
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
aap_hostname: "https://<gateway>"   # gateway URL, not controller or hub
aap_username: "<gateway_user>"
aap_password: !vault |
  $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256
  ...
aap_validate_certs: false
```
Or replace username and password with `aap_token: <gateway OAuth token>`.
